verdict.rationale: Cal.com's agents documentation explicitly points to an official Cal.com CLI for agents that can run commands, and says it handles authentication, versioning, and common workflows automatically. The evidence is a single first-party docs page with no detail. Missing for 10: installation instructions, a command reference or list of supported workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: For agents that can execute commands on a machine, use the official Cal.com CLI instead of calling the API directly.
The CLI handles authentication, versioning, and common workflows automatically.
